top_stop.bolts: M5x55 DIN 912 + M5 nyloc nut DIN 985 x2 at x = +-15, z = 113.0 (existing d5.2 body holes, no new holes)

step_jaw_mount_face_x_range_closed_mm.note: vendor STEP is in the fully closed state: the two jaw inner faces touch at x = 0 (catalog: closed 0 +0.1, open 48 +-1)

step_rear_face.m5_pattern: 40 x 22 at x=+-20, y=+-11 (link6), tap d4.13 x 7.6 deep (catalog M5x0.8x8)
step_rear_face.dowels: d4H9 x 3 at (0, +-11): round (+11) and slot (-11)
step_rear_face.verified: 4 tapped holes + 2 dowel holes found on the face z_s = -46 (opposite the jaws, jaw end face z_s = +37) in the vendor STEP

interference.note: hardware (screws/pins) checked against every other part except the part holding its thread / press fit (SMC body or jaw); heat-set inserts are the empty holes

hold_check_a.model: two pads, uniform pressure on the 50 x 45 mm patch, torque about the clamp axis X: T_cap = 2*mu*N*r_mean; combined with the shear (2W) by the friction ellipse
hold_check_a.recommendation: Pushing force 100 % (LEC step data), pushing speed <= 20 mm/s: nominal 24.3 N per finger at L = 43.2 mm (18.2 N worst case with the +-25 % accuracy); 11 N and 20 N do NOT give margin >= 1.5 for box 4 with dynamic factor 2
hold_check_a.mitigation_if_margin_too_thin: grip with the pad centre as deep as possible (s_pad = 42.5 is the zone centre); slow the lift/transport acceleration; mu of ribbed TPU on cardboard is typically > 0.5

hold_check_a_with_stop.model: static lower bound: two pads (uniform pressure, friction ellipse F/(2 mu N), T/(2 mu N r_mean)) + frictionless stop reaction F_s >= 0 along z at s = 15 (lever 27.5 mm from the pad centre, 25.7 mm above it) + gravity x 2; margin = 1 / min over F_s of the ellipse utilisation. Mechanism upper bound: box pivots about the stop contact, pads slide with mu N over the patch (mean radius 40.1 mm from the pivot).
hold_check_a_with_stop.rotate_to_hang_note: Rotate the tool about the pad axis X so that the line pad centre -> box CoG is vertical: tool axis tilted by theta = atan(d / (h/2 - 25.7)) from the downward vertical with the box far end (s > 0 side) DOWN, i.e. the spine end up toward the stop (46-48 deg boxes 1-3/5 ~ 43 deg; box 4 47 deg). In that attitude gravity produces no torque about X: the pads only carry W (margin = 2 mu N / (2 W) = 3.7 at 11 N); stop and friction torque are not needed. Whatever the transport attitude, keep the tilt within ~15 deg of that angle for accelerations; at 0 deg the stop is loaded by ~7 N.

stop_stiffness.method: voxel FE 1 mm hex8, E = 3200 MPa (PA12-CF, printed XY, conservative), nu 0.35, 29694 nodes; bolt clamp zones (r 6 mm on the side-plate inner faces) fixed; load 15 N toward the body spread over the spine-side 2 mm strip of the stop face
stop_stiffness.note: bolt/hole clearance (about 0.2 mm on the diameter, M5 in d5.4) and the clamp friction are not in the FE; with friction >= 15 N x lever / preload no slip is expected (M5 preload ~ 3 kN).

jaw_moments_b.axes: Mp about Y, My about Z (finger axis), Mr about X (stroke axis), Fv along Z (catalog p.45 figure); arms measured from the jaw mounting plane (conservative)

crush_c.reference: flat-crush strength of corrugated / folding carton board is typically >= 100 kPa (UNCONFIRMED for these cartons; not measured). Pressure at max force is ~34% of that on the rib crests.

fit_d.note: Open approach (56 mm): the box is captured within +-(20 - t/2 ...) mm laterally (+5 mm tip chamfer), and the fixed centre top-stop (x +-2, always between the pads) is hit by the box top edge at any jaw opening, so the descent can be stopped on contact (force/z) with no pre-closing. Spine-side end of the stop at s = 15; the stop only registers the 16/12 mm spine if it is within +-2 mm per side of the centre at closed; open approach centre error up to +-(gap-t)/2.

clearance_e.assumption: grip centre at s = 42.5 (middle of the 15..70 zone), link6 Y parallel to s (mirrored mounting gives identical margins: the tool is symmetric about y = 0)
clearance_e.required: fingers incl. chamfers s >= 10; nothing of this tool at s >= 90; (the other tool is assumed to exist only at s < 0)
clearance_e.flange_disc_note: the flange disc (R36) is the part closest to the spine plane of everything except the fingers (s = 6.5); it is 89 mm above the jaw plane

neighbour_proud_case.note: shared NEIGHBOUR_PROTRUSION = 15 mm (ASSUMED): a neighbour spine may stand 15 mm proud, i.e. at s = 85

mass_flange_5.note: moment about the flange-face centre with gravity perpendicular to the CoG vector (worst orientation); ReBeL permits 2 kg (flange-moment limit not given in the shared inputs)

finger_deflection.method: 2-D frame FE of the centroid line, section area / second moment sliced from the CAD every 0.5 mm, fixed at the jaw plane, 28 N (catalog max gripping force) at the pad centre z = 43.2 mm; first-order (no shear, rigid jaw interface, TPU pad ignored); isotropic printed-XY modulus

flange_disc.print_orientation: flange-side face (z = 52.7) on the bed, countersinks / insert holes open upward

gripper_plate.print_orientation: turned over: the gripper-side (top) face on the bed so the M5 countersinks open upward (no support)

top_stop.print_orientation: upside down: the stop face on the bed (4 x 55 mm), risers up, side plates last: bridges/overhang of the 16 mm wide side plates (support or print on the side with support)

finger_left.print_orientation: foot (jaw face) on the bed; column flanks 35 deg from vertical, the window ceiling is a short bridge
finger_left.support_estimate: window ceiling 56 x 6.6 mm bridge only (1 line of bridging); everything else self-supporting

pad_left.print_orientation: back (floor) face on the bed, ribs up; TPU, 0.2 mm layers, slow

pad_right.print_orientation: back (floor) face on the bed, ribs up

printability_6.inserts: M4 x 4 heat-set inserts (hole d5.6 x 4.5) x4 in the disc; M3 x 4 inserts (hole d4.2 x 5) x4 in the fingers (x2 each); floors under the blind holes are 3.0 / >= 5 mm
printability_6.min_wall_rules: min wall 3.0 mm kept everywhere except: TPU pad (2.6 base, by design), pocket side walls 3.0, stop plate 4.0 / risers 4.0 x 6.5, pad-retention cb floor in the TPU 0.7 mm (under the screw head, compressible), tip lip behind the chamfer 7.6 mm

assembly_access.inner_screw_note: screws seated with the fingers on the OPEN jaws; the window under the pad block is 10.5 mm high (screw M3x8 drops in vertically, driver ball-end key swung >= 15 deg toward the gap)
assembly_access.m4_note: the M4 plate screws are driven BEFORE the stop yoke is fitted (the yoke side plates / M5 heads sit in the driver column); to remove them take the yoke off first

fasteners.m3_thread_pullout_ref_N: M3 12.9 steel proof load ~ 4.5 kN; 3.8 mm engagement in aluminium jaw ~ 1.5 kN
